title: John Yonge Anderson Morshead
dates: (11 June 1846-1923)
---

cousin of CMY, barrister

Eldest son of the Rev.

John Philip Anderson Morshead and Alethea Yonge, he graduated from University College Oxford in 1869, and qualified as a barrister at the Middle Temple in 1873.

He married (21 April 1880) his cousin Helen Beatrice Anderson Morshead (1853/4-1922).

He was interested in local history and has an obituary in Transactions of the Devonshire Association 55,56 (1924).
